text: 本文是一项系统评价。我们截至2026年8月30日检索PubMed和万方，PubMed式为 hydrogel[Title/Abstract] AND biomaterial[Title/Abstract]，万方式为 主题=(水凝胶 AND 生物材料)。预先规定纳入与排除标准，完成文献去重，由两名审阅者独立进行题名、摘要与全文筛选，PRISMA流程图记录检出、筛选与排除数量。
gold_reason: 系统评价是中文医学文献中 systematic review 的常用等价自指；类型、两库、日期、两库检索式、纳排、文献去重、双人筛选和流程数量均完整。

text: No systematic review was undertaken. MEDLINE was searched through 30 August 2026, and we selected studies to illustrate prospective validation rather than to estimate literature coverage.
gold_reason: No systematic review was undertaken 是被动式明确否定；后句给出叙述性来源、日期、目的性选择和不估计覆盖率边界。

text: We conducted a systematic review. PsycINFO was searched through 30 August 2026 with TX "hydrogel*" N3 TX "machine learning". Eligibility criteria were prespecified. Duplicate bibliographic records were removed. Two reviewers independently screened titles, abstracts, and full texts. A PRISMA flow chart accounts for records identified, screened, and excluded.
gold_reason: PsycINFO/EBSCOhost 的 TX 字段和 N3 邻近算符构成数据库特异的结构性可执行式信号，其余系统选择记录完整。

text: This narrative review searched Scopus until 30 August 2026. Query concepts were: hydrogel; scaffold; nanoparticle; tissue repair; machine learning. We selected studies to illustrate contrasting validation designs; the selection was not intended to be comprehensive.
gold_reason: Query concepts 后的五项分号清单是查询概念库存，不含字段、受控词表或可重跑数据库语法；透明叙述范围仍成立，但应提示伪检索式风险。

text: We conducted a systematic review. PubMed was searched through 30 August 2026. Inclusion and exclusion criteria were predefined; duplicate bibliographic records were removed; two reviewers independently screened titles, abstracts, and full texts; a PRISMA flow diagram reports records identified, screened, and excluded. In the rheology subsection, TS = 25 °C denotes the thermal-setting temperature of the hydrogel.
gold_reason: TS = 25 °C 是水凝胶热设定温度变量，不是 Web of Science 检索字段；系统综述仍缺可执行检索式或现存补充记录。

text: We conducted a systematic review. PubMed was searched through 30 August 2026 using hydrogel[Title/Abstract]. Eligibility criteria were predefined, and duplicate bibliographic records were removed. For a cohort discussed in the Results, two clinicians independently screened electronic health records, and its flow chart reports records identified, screened, and excluded before outcome modelling.
gold_reason: 同段后半的电子健康记录筛选和患者队列流程图属于临床数据处理，不是文献题录筛选或文献选择流程。

text: We conducted a systematic review. MEDLINE was searched through 30 August 2026 using hydrogel*.tw. Eligibility criteria were predefined. Two reviewers independently screened titles, abstracts, and full texts, and a PRISMA flow diagram reports records identified, screened, and excluded. During assay preprocessing, duplicate records from the spectrometer were removed before calibration.
gold_reason: 光谱仪产生的 duplicate records 是仪器数据，不是检索所得题录；文献去重没有报告。

text: This narrative review searched PubMed through 30 August 2026. We selected representative experiments rather than an exhaustive census. Article PDFs were obtained on publisher platforms; DOI landing pages served to corroborate author names, year, and retraction status.
gold_reason: obtained article PDFs 清楚表示全文获取，corroborate author/year/retraction status 清楚表示元数据与发表状态核验；不能因未用 retrieve/verify 固定动词而报警。

text: This narrative review searched Scopus through August 2026. We selected illustrative studies rather than an exhaustive census. A librarian-built author-curated full-text collection drew on weekly updates and society archives during 2019–2025. Additions had to meet the identical inclusion criteria, and provenance was retained.
gold_reason: 资料库的负责主体、来源类型、时间边界、同一纳入规则和来源保留均已披露；inclusion 作名词仍是清楚的进入规则。

text: We conducted a systematic review. Embase was searched through 30 August 2026. Eligibility criteria were predefined; duplicate bibliographic records were removed; two reviewers independently screened titles, abstracts, and full texts; the PRISMA flow diagram reports records identified, screened, and excluded. The Supplementary Search Strategy is slated for deposit after peer review and is not included in the current files.
gold_reason: slated for deposit after peer review 且当前文件未包含，明确表示未来附件；不得作为现存检索策略满足系统门禁。

text: We conducted a systematic review. Web of Science was searched through 30 August 2026. Eligibility criteria were predefined; duplicate bibliographic records were removed; two reviewers independently screened titles, abstracts, and full texts; a PRISMA flow chart accounts for records identified, screened, and excluded. Database-specific strings and run dates are provided in Supplementary Methods S3.
gold_reason: 现在时 are provided 明确指向现存 Supplementary Methods S3，且其内容为各数据库字符串与运行日期；信息顺序倒置不应造成漏识别。

text:
This narrative review searched MEDLINE through 30 August 2026.

We selected studies to compare validation designs. The article is not a systematic review.

The examples are illustrative rather than an exhaustive census.
gold_reason: 两句分别交代文体不是系统综述和案例不作穷尽推断，功能不同，不应机械判成重复免责声明。

text: This narrative review discusses PubMedBERT and ScopusNet model versions in biomedical natural-language processing. It does not report how literature was found.
gold_reason: PubMedBERT 和 ScopusNet 是模型名而非书目数据库，model versions 也不是文献版本处理；应保持叙述综述的部分披露。

text: This review cites the prior article “A systematic review of hydrogel screening” for terminology; our article is a narrative review based on representative examples and does not claim comprehensive coverage.
gold_reason: 引号内是既往论文题名，后半才是本文明确的 narrative review 自指；被引用题名中的方法词不得覆盖本文类型。

text: This review was planned as a systematic review, but no systematic search or record screening was conducted; the final article is a narrative review using illustrative cases, and it does not claim exhaustive coverage.
gold_reason: planned as 后接明确否定和 final article is a narrative review；最终实施的文体应优先于已放弃的计划。

text: We conducted a systematic review. PubMed was searched through 30 August 2026 using "Biocompatible Materials"[Majr] AND "Review"[Publication Type]. Eligibility criteria were predefined; duplicate bibliographic records were removed; two reviewers independently screened titles, abstracts, and full texts; a PRISMA flow diagram reports records identified, screened, and excluded.
gold_reason: [Majr] 和 [Publication Type] 是 PubMed 合法字段标签，不能因字段白名单未列出而把完整系统记录误判为缺检索式。
